hotspots.title: Adorni scandal deepens
hotspots.blurb: Manuel Adorni, Argentina's Chief of Cabinet, faces intense scrutiny over alleged illicit enrichment, including a $5.8 million purchase using subordinates' credit cards. His potential resignation looms as President Javier Milei returns from Spain, with Diego Santilli tipped as his replacement.
hotspots.affect: The scandal commands disproportionate attention due to its moral outrage, political fallout, and the high stakes for Milei's government credibility.

hotspots.title: AfD ban debate intensifies
hotspots.blurb: Germany's far-right Alternative für Deutschland (AfD) faces a potential ban after a legal report deemed it unconstitutional. Over 1.3 million citizens signed a petition supporting the ban, while the party's leadership changes and rising poll numbers fuel the debate.
hotspots.affect: The debate is charged due to fears of democratic erosion, moral panic over far-right extremism, and polarized political contention.

hotspots.title: Vox-PP coalition tensions rise
hotspots.blurb: Spain's far-right Vox party threatens to withdraw support from regional coalitions with the center-right Partido Popular (PP) if agreements are not honored. Tensions escalate over issues like LGBTQ+ rights, immigration, and housing policies.
hotspots.affect: The tensions command attention due to the high-stakes political alliances, moral outrage over policy disputes, and polarized contention between the parties.
